passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: The chaptered text prints a binding dated renewable-procurement duty on retail sellers, but it names no actor, so it cannot by itself attribute the bill to this person.

rows.reasoning: SB 100 (2017-2018) is on-question and its operative text is a binding dated renewable-procurement duty reaching "60 percent by December 31, 2030", which would match "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines." (the 100% clause beside it is only "the policy of the state"). But the only act in the sources is an Assembly Floor Aye recorded 08/28/18, and this person's service in this body is established only from 2022-12-05, with the earlier Assembly term carrying no start date, so the 2018 vote is not established as his act in this office. With no passage surviving V1/V5, the row is BLANK.
